name: strict-scope-reverse-engineering
description: Evidence-backed binary, bytecode, APK, .NET assembly, and network protocol inspection tools.

tools.name: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)
tools.role: Unified MCP/CLI orchestration for binaries, JS/Electron, APKs, and captures

tools.name: Ghidra / IDA / Binary Ninja / Rizin / radare2
tools.role: Native disassembly, decompilation, and CFG analysis

tools.name: CFR / Vineflower / Bytecode Viewer / javap
tools.role: JVM bytecode decompilation and class structure inspection

tools.name: JADX / apktool
tools.role: Android APK/DEX decompilation and resource decoding

tools.name: .NET ILSpy / dnSpyEx / dotPeek / monodis
tools.role: .NET managed assembly CIL and metadata inspection

tools.name: Frida
tools.role: Authorized dynamic instrumentation and runtime tracing

tools.name: Wireshark / tshark / mitmproxy / tcpdump
tools.role: Packet capture and HTTP(S) protocol analysis

tools.name: Binwalk / Detect It Easy
tools.role: Firmware extraction and binary packing/signature identification

tools.name: GDB / LLDB / strace / lsof
tools.role: Native crash triage and syscall/process inspection
